# Feature: Game Setup Starting Player Options

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
In Spieleinstellungen (GameSetup bot phase), add exclusive checkboxes to force human (p1) or opponent/bot (p2) as starting player; neither checked keeps initiative/default. Wire through `onStart` → `createGame({ startingPlayer })` and MatchIntro so initiative does not overwrite a forced choice.

## Preconditions
- App open on Play → Gegen Bot setup (`phase === 'bot'`)
- Spieleinstellungen modal available (`game-setup-settings`)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Modal shows checkboxes „Immer Spieler beginnt“ (`data-testid="game-setup-start-player"`) and „Immer Gegner beginnt“ (`data-testid="game-setup-start-opponent"`) below Artefakt-Auktion
- [ ] Default: both unchecked
- [ ] Checking one unchecks the other (radio-like exclusive)
- [ ] Unchecking the active one returns to neither-checked (default)
- [ ] Neither checked → Partie starten keeps current default (createGame + MatchIntro initiative as today)
- [ ] Spieler checked → `createGame({ startingPlayer: 'p1' })` and MatchIntro uses p1 without overwriting via dice
- [ ] Gegner checked → `createGame({ startingPlayer: 'p2' })` and MatchIntro uses p2
- [ ] V5 info card + Artefakt-Auktion remain in modal; Modal dismissible unchanged

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Closing/reopening modal preserves start-player checkbox state for the setup session
- [ ] Forced starter still runs MatchIntro VS → winner announce → arena (no stuck initiative)

## Regression
- [ ] Artefakt-Auktion wiring unchanged
- [ ] Charakterauswahl / Zufällig / Partie starten still work
- [ ] When neither forced, initiative W6 still decides starter

## Assumptions
- Solo: human = p1, bot = p2
- Exclusive selection via two checkboxes (not native radio), useState only
- Forced starter skips dice roll in MatchIntro but still calls `onInitiativeResolved` so deal rebuild stays consistent
